info.title: Fuse API
info.description: Lorum (Fuse) clearing, settlement and treasury API: multi-currency accounts, payments, exchanges, transfers, customers/KYC, documents, batch payments and sandbox simulation. Harvested from the provider's public ReadMe reference (per-operation OpenAPI definitions).

Select one or more license types that the customer holds. If the customer

License issuer type. Use Mainland for businesses registered with the UAE mainland authority,
or Freezone for businesses registered in a UAE free zone.

Name of the beneficiary account.

**Note:** When the `beneficiary_type` is `individual`, the name may not contain any digits.
**Note:** When the payment currency is `USD`, max length 35 characters.

account_identifier.description: External account identifier of the beneficiary account.

address.description:
Address of the beneficiary account.

**Note:** When the payment currency is `USD`, the following field restrictions apply:
- **Line 1:** Required, maximum length 35 characters.
- **Line 2:** Required, maximum length 35 characters.
- **Line 3:** Optional, maximum length 20 characters (city or postcode/zipcode recommended).)

Name of the account holder. This is the name that

A list of addressable account identifiers associated with this account.
These identifiers can be used to receive money into the account.
Please note that this can contain multiple details addressable over
a different payment schemes.

available_balance.description:
Sum of the immediate available funds in the account.
This includes transactions that have not yet been cleared.

currency.description: What currency the account holds funds in.

current_balance.description: Sum of all the money in the account.

The account's externally addressable detail.
It is used as details when sending money into the account,
and will show up un the account statements.

counterpart_account_id.description:
When `direction` is `Inbound` it is the ID of the account that was debited
When `direction` is 'Outbound' it is the ID of the account that was credited

counterpart_amount.description:
When `direction` is `Inbound` it is the counterpart transaction amount that was debited from the counterpart account.
When `direction` is `Outbound` it is the counterpart transaction amount that was credited from the counterpart account.

counterpart_currency.description:
When `direction` is `Inbound` it is the currency of the counterpart transaction from counterpart account.
When `direction` is `Outbound` it is the currency of the counterpart transaction into the counterpart account.

currency.description:
When `direction` is `Inbound` it is the currency for the amount credited into the account.
When `direction` is `Outbound` it is the currency for the amount that was debited from the account.

direction.description: Whether this transaction credits or debits the account.

executed_at.description: When the transaction was cleared by the bank.

oneOf.description: Why the transaction was rejected.

instructed_amount.description:
When `direction` is `Inbound` it is the amount that was credited into the account.
When `direction` is `Outbound` it is the amount that was debited from the account.

rate.description: The exchange rate used for the transaction.

submitted_at.description: When the transaction was submitted to the bank.

account_id.description: The account that the transfer applies to.
